design_philosophy: The Living Chronicle Tome. Fusion of medieval illuminated manuscript aesthetics with modern audio DAW & tactical RPG HUD controls. Intimate, atmospheric, literary, and deeply responsive.

color_system.archetype: Organic & Tactical Dark Fantasy (Illuminated Parchment & Ink Void)
rules: No pure black #000000 — always use tinted obsidian #0B0C10
Contrast ratios minimum 4.5:1 for prose text (#F0E6D2 on #12141A)
Gold accents (#D4AF37) used exclusively for active states, key CTAs, and rare items
Crimson (#DC2626) reserved for critical health, combat actions, and warnings
Mana/Arcane highlights (#0EA5E9 / #8B5CF6) reserved for AI narration state, audio voice waves, and intelligence stats

typography.pairing_strategy: Editorial Manuscript Serif Headings + Modern Clean Readable Sans Body + Precision Monospace Tactical Stats

type_scale.h1_title: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight font-heading text-amber-100
type_scale.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight font-heading text-amber-200/90
type_scale.body_prose: text-lg sm:text-xl leading-relaxed font-prose text-stone-200 tracking-wide

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing, multi-column asymmetric bento cards, cardless dark panels with subtle metallic inner borders and optical padding.

grid_modes.gameplay_screen: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 h-[calc(100vh-4rem)] overflow-hidden
grid_modes.content_library: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6 sm:gap-8

textures: Subtle SVG parchment noise grain overlay on background
Gold leaf metallic borders using linear-gradient standard borders
Audio visualizer spectrum bar animations during AI voice narration

glassmorphism.hud_floats: backdrop-blur-md bg-[#12141A]/90 border border-[#D4AF37]/30 shadow-2xl shadow-black/80

navigation_header.description: Top persistent navigation bar with Brand Logo 'IRGS Chronicle', Mode status, Player Profile, Quick Campaign Switcher, AI Provider Selector badge, and Store link.

auth_screen.description: Split screen layout with left cinematic medieval artwork & quote, right illuminated parchment sign-in card with Google OAuth + Email/Password toggle.

content_library_screen.description: Grid of medieval-fantasy and historical campaign cards. Filterable by Genre, Difficulty, and Unlocked/Locked status. Displays play counts, tags, and 'Resume' or 'Begin Campaign' buttons.

character_creator_screen.description: 5-step interactive parchment sheet. Left column: Portrait preview with AI prompt generator or upload. Center: Attributes sliders (Strength, Agility, Arcana, Charisma), Background choice, Special Traits. Right: Inventory setup & Live summary.

gameplay_screen.description: The centerpiece experience! 3-Column Layout: Left (World State & Character Quick Panel: HP/Mana bars, Inventory, World Clock, Quest Tracker); Center (Narrative Feed: Scrolling prose, scene image, audio player bar, action input box with Voice Mic + Text submit); Right (AI Model & Voice Controls, Checkpoints & Auto-save status, Chronicle quick log).

saves_checkpoints_screen.description: Timeline view of auto-saves, manual checkpoints, and branched timelines. Allows restoring, creating named checkpoints, branching new timelines, and exporting save state JSON.

chronicle_screen.description: Filterable timeline journal of all committed story beats, decisions made, key NPCs met, and locations visited. Searchable by chapter or tag.

store_account_screen.description: Merchant's bazaar for premium campaign packs, voice narrator packs, and AI token passes. Integrates payment modals (PayPal, Paystack, Razorpay) and account entitlement list.

castles_and_landscapes.description: Foggy Burg Eltz Castle — used for Shadows over Eldoria campaign banner
Abandoned Gothic Castle — used for Siege of Ironhold scenario
Castle at night under dramatic skies — used for Auth screen cinematic background

character_portraits.description: Mystic warrior with glowing blue eyes — Rogue Spellblade portrait option
Female warrior holding sword — Paladin / Mercenary portrait
Knight in heavy historical armor — Crusader / Veteran Commander portrait

maps_and_manuscripts.description: Close up vintage parchment map — used for World Map panel & Store banners
Leather-bound antique manuscript volume — used for Chronicle header

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive components have the specified data-testid attributes for E2E verification.
Use Framer Motion for smooth tab switches, feed item entrance animations, audio waveform pulsation, and modal slide-ins.
The core gameplay screen feed must auto-scroll smoothly to the latest narrative entry upon submission.

Provide interactive mock features for AI Voice playback (Web Speech API or realistic simulated audio waves), AI Model selection, Save/Restore state management in local storage or state, and Store payment flow modals.
Keep typography clean with Cinzel for titles, EB Garamond for narrative prose, and Plus Jakarta Sans / Fira Code for HUD UI & metrics.
DO NOT use raw transparent backgrounds on dropdowns or float panels; always use backdrop-blur with semi-opaque dark obsidian surface.
